jobs.description: As a Product Manager, you are responsible for your own product group within the warehouse. You check stock levels and product quality, decide where products should be stored and ensure that orders are shipped on time according to the FIFO principle (First In, First Out). You communicate daily with the Sales department, team leaders and order pickers, making sure you maintain an overview of the entire flow of goods.Your responsibilities include:- Checking stock levels and monitoring the quality and ripeness of fruit and vegetables;- Processing incoming and outgoing goods according to the FIFO principle (First In, First Out);- Communicating with Sales about available stock and shipping priorities;- Instructing and informing order pickers through the daily planning;- Solving problems independently and responding quickly to changes;- Moving pallets using a forklift or reach truck when necessary.- You are well organised and can maintain a good overview;- You take responsibility and can work independently;- You communicate easily with different departments, including Sales and Management;- You speak English (Dutch is a plus);- You have experience in logistics and are willing to learn about the products;- A forklift or reach truck certificate is an advantage but not required. We are able to arrange the necessary training for you.
